_template: The Desk. Copy to .mcp.json at the repo root and replace @HOME@ and @VAULT_BOX@. That file is NOT tracked — **/.mcp.json is globally ignored on an operator box because it carries absolute paths and a seat identity, the same rule deploy/kart-sandbox.template.json follows: the template travels, the wiring does not.
_why_here: This repo is Willow's Grove. Opening it at the root seats you as willow — the Desk is the default, not a subdirectory you have to know about. Heimdallr's Watch is a seat you deliberately open at seat/heimdallr/. Ratified 2026-09-09.
